meta.name: manage-channels
meta.description: Wire channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, add new channel groups. Use after adding a channel, during setup, or standalone to reconfigure.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将频道连接到代理组并管理隔离级别
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理多个频道与代理组的映射关系
copy.tagline_en: Wire channels to agent groups and manage isolation levels
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage mappings between channels and agent groups

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会检查现有消息渠道与智能体群的连接,让你提供平台 ID、选择隔离级别,再运行注册命令把渠道接上;也能新增渠道群、调整已有连接、展示配置摘要。
howto.when: 在添加新渠道后、初始搭建期间,或单独要求重新配置渠道连接时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个 Telegram 群接到我的智能体上。
say.note: 它会先问隔离级别和平台 ID。

say.text: 新增一个渠道群,接给已有智能体。
say.note: 它会问隔离问题,再走新增群流程。

say.text: 显示当前渠道和智能体群的连接配置。
say.note: 列出已接线、已配置未接线和未配置的渠道。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude inspects current wiring, asks for platform ID and isolation choice, then runs register to connect a channel to an agent group. It can also add channel groups, change wirings, and show a config summary.
howto.when_en: Triggered after adding a channel, during initial setup, or when asked to reconfigure channel connections.

say_en.text: Connect this Telegram group to my assistant.
say_en.note: It first asks for the isolation level and platform ID.

say_en.text: Add another channel group for an existing assistant.
say_en.note: It asks the isolation question, then runs the group-add flow.

say_en.text: Show current channel and agent-group connections.
say_en.note: Lists wired, configured-but-unwired, and unconfigured channels.
